projects.title: MicroCommerce — Microservices E-Commerce Platform
projects.description: .NET 8 microservices e-commerce platform: 5 services behind an Ocelot gateway, asynchronous checkout via MassTransit/RabbitMQ, JWT auth, and xUnit integration tests enforced in GitHub Actions CI.
projects.details:
A .NET 8 e-commerce platform built as independent microservices, focused on scalability, reliable messaging and automated testing.

Architecture:
  • 5 microservices, each with its own database:
    • Catalog.API (MongoDB)
    • Basket.API (Redis)
    • Ordering.API (PostgreSQL)
    • Identity.API (PostgreSQL, JWT auth)
    • Messages.API (PostgreSQL)
  • OcelotGateway as the single entry point and router for all services.
  • Asynchronous checkout: Basket and Order communicate through MassTransit over RabbitMQ.

Backend & Security:
  • .NET 8 Web APIs following clean architecture principles.
  • JWT-based authentication and authorization via Identity.API.
  • Docker & Docker Compose for containerized deployment.

Quality:
  • xUnit integration tests.
  • Integration tests run against the live stack in GitHub Actions and must pass before any Docker image is published.

Frontend:
  • React-based SPA (SwiftShop).
  • Buyer↔seller messaging (Messages.API) and an admin panel.

projects.title: Maxxing — Social Habit Tracking App
projects.description: Social habit tracking app with an ASP.NET Core (.NET 10) + PostgreSQL API and a React Native (Expo) client. Features JWT auth, email verification, timezone-aware streaks, invite-code groups and Turkish/English localization.

projects.title: EEG-Based Emotion Recognition (TÜBİTAK 2209-A)
projects.description: TÜBİTAK 2209-A funded research: systematic review of 136 papers on deep learning for EEG emotion recognition, plus a hybrid 1D CNN-LSTM implemented on the DREAMER dataset (EEG + ECG).
projects.details:
A research project funded by the TÜBİTAK 2209-A Undergraduate Research Projects Program, combining a large-scale literature study with a practical deep learning implementation for emotion recognition.

Systematic Review:
  • Systematic review of 136 papers on deep learning for EEG-based emotion recognition.
  • Comparison of the architectures, datasets and preprocessing approaches used in the literature.

Implementation:
  • Hybrid 1D CNN-LSTM model: CNN layers extract local signal features, LSTM layers capture temporal dependencies.
  • Trained and evaluated on the DREAMER dataset using both EEG and ECG signals.
  • Signal preprocessing and segmentation before training.

Achievements:
  • TÜBİTAK project leadership experience
  • Academic research and systematic literature review
  • Biomedical signal processing proficiency

projects.title: Transportation Route Planning System

projects.details:
This project is a desktop application that integrates public transport and taxi systems in Kocaeli/Izmit to calculate the most efficient route (shortest/fastest) from a user's current location. It is developed using Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles.

  • API: Google Maps API
  • Database: SQL, JSON
  • Architecture: OOP (Object Oriented Programming)
